Resolves #3063

Updates `buildScripts/create/app.mjs` so newly scaffolded apps generate `view/ViewportController.mjs` (`extends Neo.controller.Component` from `src/controller/Component.mjs`) and wire `controller: ViewportController` into `view/Viewport.mjs`, matching `buildScripts/create/class.mjs` (`controller.Component`) and `apps/*/view/Viewport.mjs` conventions.

Evidence: L2 (CLI app generation & file verification in `createApp.spec.mjs`) → L2 required (`#3063` `create-app` scaffolding).

Micro-review eligible: single-concern CLI scaffold addition (`ViewportController.mjs` generation + `Viewport.mjs` controller binding) with unit spec coverage in `createApp.spec.mjs`.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createApp.spec.mjs` (`create/app.mjs merges and deduplicates framework and workspace themes in --help and app generation`) |

## Deltas from ticket
Uses `ViewportController` bound to `Viewport` (`view/ViewportController.mjs` + `controller: ViewportController` in `view/Viewport.mjs`) rather than `MainViewController`, matching `create-app`'s root view (`Viewport.mjs`) and `buildScripts/create/class.mjs` naming conventions (`appMinimal.mjs` already pairs `MainView.mjs` with `MainViewController.mjs`).

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

- [ ] None required beyond CI unit suite (`test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createApp.spec.mjs`).

### `@neo-opus-vega` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-03T19:25:55Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — a 31-line scaffold addition that applies an existing engine convention to generated apps: a `ViewportController` bound through the `controller` config, as in `apps/portal`, `apps/form` and `apps/workstation`. It introduces no abstraction, contract or config.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** `#3063` asks `create-app` to scaffold a view controller. `appMinimal.mjs` already writes an empty `MainViewController` (l.269–281), so the expected shape for `app.mjs`'s Viewport was the same. The diff matches it at `117550572a`, and it touches only the script the ticket names plus its spec:
- the controller's import uses the same `insideNeo` switch as the Viewport's imports;
- the `controller` JSDoc block matches the engine apps word for word (`@member {Neo.controller.Component} controller=ViewportController`, `@reactive`);
- the spec runs the real script in a `mkdtemp` workspace and removes it afterwards.

The spec only matches substrings, so I ran the one falsifier it can't: I generated `DemoApp` from the PR head in a temp workspace and ran `node --check` on `view/Viewport.mjs`, `view/ViewportController.mjs` and `app.mjs`. All three pass. Required CI is 16/16 green at this head. `Resolves #3063` stands alone, and the commit subject ends `(#3063)`.

One consequence lands outside this repository. neo-app writes a workspace's first app from its own copy of this template (`create-app/tasks/createViewport.mjs`), and that copy has no controller. After the next engine release, a workspace's first app and the apps added to it would differ. That isn't this PR's to fix: it's filed as neomjs/create-app#52 and lands with the pin bump.

**Findings:** None.
